code: read_trackball(   paths,   setup = c("of_free", "of_fixed"),   sampling_rate,   col_time = "time",   col_dx = "x",   col_dy = "y",   ball_calibration = NULL,   ball_diameter = NULL,   distance_scale = NULL,   distance_unit = NULL,   verbose = FALSE )

title: Read trackball data — read_trackball
text: paths Two file paths, one sensor (although one allowed fixed setup, of_fixed). setup type experimental setup used. Expects either of_free of_fixed. sampling_rate Sampling rate tells function long time integrate . sampling rate 60(Hz) mean windows 1/60 sec used integrate . col_time column contains information time. Can specified either column number (numeric) name column one (character). either datetime (POSIXt) seconds (numeric). col_dx Column name x-axis values col_dy Column name y-axis values ball_calibration running of_fixed experiment, may (necessary) provide calibration factor. factor number recorded 360 degree spin. can use calibrate_trackball function get number. Alternatively, provide ball_diameter distance_scale (e.g. mouse dpcm). ball_diameter running of_fixed experiment, ball diameter needed together either ball_calibration distance_scale. distance_scale using computer mice, might getting unit-less data . However, computer mice factor called "dots-per-cm", can use convert estimates centimeters. distance_unit unit used. distance_scale also used, unit scaled data. E.g. trackball data optical flow sensors, can use mouse dots-per-cm (dpcm) 394 setting distance_unit = "cm" distance_scale = 394. verbose FALSE (default), suppress warning messages.
